title: CODEOWNERS still requests both maintainers on a low-risk skills PR the relay no longer summons them for
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: the at-tier contract review 6890432656 on PR #33686, card #33540, escalated this outside its diff).

## 维护者速读

#33540 让中继在「低风险技能臂」读成 Tier S 的 PR 上不再请你和 os-zhuang 审。但 `.github/CODEOWNERS` 第 43、53 行把 `/skills/` 和 `/ui/skills/` 指给你们两位，草稿转 ready 时 GitHub 会自己按 code owner 请审，所以这类 PR 仍会出现在你们的待审列表里。CODEOWNERS 是受管面(Tier H),改不改、怎么改由你定。

## Facts (on `main`)

- `.github/CODEOWNERS` L43 `/skills/ @os-zhuang @hotlong`, L53 `/ui/skills/ @os-zhuang @hotlong`.
- GitHub requests code owners itself when a draft PR is marked ready, whatever the relay plans. So the harm card #33540 names (the maintainers summoned on a PR they are not asked to merge) is not removed by PR #33686 alone.
- Whether the ruleset requires code-owner review is a separate setting; this card does not assume it.

## Options for the maintainer

- A. Leave CODEOWNERS as is: low-risk skills PRs show in your queue; the seat still lands them and nobody waits on you.
- B. Narrow the two rows (for example to the security-named catalog paths and `evals/`-free files is not expressible; so likely a team or a single owner), accepting that CODEOWNERS cannot read the arm's other conditions.
- C. Remove the two rows and rely on the governed register plus the relay plan.

## Scope

`.github/CODEOWNERS` only, Tier H. ⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
